youtube_short.title: Zombie Debt: Your Dead Debt Can Rise Again
title_alternatives: One Word Resets Your 7-Year Debt Clock
Collectors Buy Your Dead Debt for 2 Cents on the Dollar
youtube_short.description: Your old debt legally died — but there's an $88 billion industry that buys it for pennies and tries to scare you into making a single small payment. That one payment legally resurrects the statute of limitations and gives them 3-7 more years to chase you. Here's what zombie debt is, how the trap works, and exactly what to say (nothing) when they call. Know your rights under the FDCPA. #finance #money #debt #personalfinance #debtfree

hook_line: Your dead debt can rise again 🧟
